ticket.subject: Cannot upload files over 10 MB
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

I'm the project manager at Tidewell Logistics. Any PDF above roughly 10 MB stops at 99% and then shows an upload error.

Your docs say the limit is 50 MB on our plan. Smaller files upload fine, so we split the large ones for now. Here is a screen recording of the problem: https://share.example.com/rec/8f3a2c?token=q7Rk2mZx91 Our office egress IP is 198.51.100.23, in case that helps with the logs.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Could you check what is going wrong?

Yours sincerely,
Ingrid Delacroix
